messages:
auditor_maria: Hi team, auditor request: need evidence for RBAC changes from 2024-12-02 deploy window and any ephemeral KMS keys used. Please provide a minimal provenance bundle and sampling rationale.

omar_ops: ack. We'll gather PR approvals, merged commit diff, k8s audit slice (RoleBinding apply), and deploy trace from deploy-bot. ETA ~30m.

nina_sec: For KMS: ephemeral keys are brokered by kb-service. We'll export CloudTrail entries for CreateKey/RotateKey within the window and a signed manifest from CN=redwood-kms-operator.

auditor_maria: Prefer PGP or RSA-signed attestation and sha256 checksums for exported files. Also include a deterministic sampling plan (time window or request-id prefix).

omar_ops: Sampling plan: time window 2024-12-02T04:50:00Z-2024-12-02T05:20:00Z; include RequestIDs with prefix dep- and KeyId prefix ephemeral-20241202. We'll provide sha256 sums.

deply-bot: rollout start 2024-12-02T05:00:03Z service=auth-mgr image=sha256:bead1234 nodes=[gke-1,gke-2] status=successful

nina_sec: We'll redact PII, include redaction log, and add mapping doc tying artifacts to SOC2 controls (CC6.2, CC7.1). PGP attestation id: 0xDEADBEEF.

omar_ops: presigned links will be posted when export completes. Also including a short runbook excerpt for ephemeral key rotation failures.

auditor_maria: Good. After you post links I'll validate checksums and the signature. If anything's missing I'll request a scoped follow-up. Thanks.
